svg.text: BEN Engine — Power One-Line — BEN 300 (300 kW IT, 2 liquid racks, N+1) — Schreiber AI — IFR Rev 2.A · 2026-11-09
480Y/277 V · service 600 A · 1 × Galaxy VL 500 kVA · 2 × 32.6 kWh Li-ion (11.7 min) · 2 CDUs on UPS · fan coils + skid not on UPS · PUE est. 1.102
SPD Type 1 · GES bond · ATS / generator inlet option
Rack feeds 480Y/277 V direct to the rack power shelves, A from UPS1 / B from UPS1, tap boxes on the power tray over the aisle; no transformer, no 208 V PDUs.
CDU pumps ride through on the UPS so the cold plates never lose flow; fan coils and the skid (dry coolers, trim chiller) are on the mechanical bus.
skid: dry coolers + trim chiller 33.0 kW
lights, receptacles · EPO sheds this bus
Interference / code checks: I-D5 gear 1,067 mm (cond. 2), I-D4 / I-D6 racks and CDUs 914 mm with ENV-LINER-NC (EN-001)
I-D12 UPS N × 500 ≥ IT/0.95 × 1.15 · I-D13 battery power · I-D14 NFPA 855 groups (UL 9540A needed for adjacent groups)
EPO: recessed in the door-end frame + exterior station on SVC → shunt-trips UPS outputs and the mechanical main
Aisle-wall liner is non-conductive and NOT bonded; every other metal part bonded to the TMGB
